Represents an array of string values for a single matrix parameter.

## Signature

```typescript
export type JsonTemplateMatrixContent = string[];
```

## Remarks

Each matrix parameter defined in [JsonTemplateMatrix](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/typealiases/jsontemplatematrix) contains an array of string values that will be used during Cartesian product expansion. All values must be strings to ensure consistent template substitution via Liquid syntax.

Example for an operating system parameter:

```js
["linux", "darwin", "win32"]
```
During template expansion, each value is combined with values from other matrix parameters to generate all possible combinations.
